question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Lend an ear
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"lend an ear"** means** to listen closely** or pay attention to what someone is saying. (ध्यान से सुनना)

 
 
• **Example: **Whenever I have a problem, she always** lends an ear **and offers great advice.
 
 
 
• **"To listen closely"** means to pay careful attention to what someone is saying or to a sound. (ध्यान से सुनना)
 
 
• **Example: **During the lecture, the students **listened closely to the professor's explanation.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To go to remote places** (दूरस्थ स्थानों पर जाना): To travel to places that are far away and not easily accessible.

 
 
• **Example:** He loves adventure and often goes to remote places for trekking.
 
 
 
• **Impossible task** (असंभव कार्य): A task that is very difficult or cannot be done.
 
 
• **Example: **Climbing Mount Everest without any training is an impossible task.
 
 
 
• **To lend something important** (कुछ महत्वपूर्ण उधार देना): To give something valuable or essential to someone for a temporary period.
 
 
• **Example: **She was kind enough to lend me her notes before the exam.
 
 

32:Ta7f,
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
